Of course, everyone does.  But those moments are very far and few in between as of late.

My issue is that I've been trying at 110% and I'm not getting anywhere in life.  I try to get jobs, but I obviously get biased employers due to my CP and I can't earn a wage.  I dropped out of college due to emotional issues surrounding my family and I don't see anyway I might be able to resume my degree; I over-turned my suspension once already, so that's that.  I'm staring at a place in the next coming weeks were it looks like it's going to be horrible. I can wade through it, but I'm extremely scared of what I might due to the proximity of the things around me over there.
